title: BeginnerURLPreviewFetcher
description: A URL preview API that accepts only HTTP(S) URLs and returns bounded title and metadata for a remote page. It must block loopback, private, link-local, and multicast destinations before connect and before every redirect, allow at most 3 redirects, and cap the response at 1 MiB or provide metadata-only output.
generation_notes: Accept only HTTP(S) URLs with valid hostnames; reject unsupported schemes and malformed ports before any connection.
Resolve and reject loopback, private, link-local, and multicast addresses before connect and again before each redirect target is connected.
Follow no more than 3 redirects, and reject redirect loops or redirects to a disallowed address.
Enforce a maximum 1 MiB response body and bounded metadata parsing; metadata-only mode must avoid downloading an unbounded body.
Set connection and total-operation timeouts so a slow or oversized remote response cannot consume unbounded resources.
